findings.title: Checker still authorizes semantic governance, evidence and secret violations

location.symbol: Automated checks and deterministic checker contract

findings.observation: The repaired checker strips fenced code and HTML comments, but its renderedMarkdown model retains four-space indented code while tableCells trims indentation. Consequently indented canonical portfolio and ChangeRecord tables are treated as authoritative even though Markdown renders them as code rather than the required tables. Its credential matcher permits only one arbitrary prefix segment, so NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENAI_API_KEY with a production-shaped value is not detected, and its general evidence predicate accepts any forty-character hexadecimal string without proving reachability. Independently, arbitrary actor/feature/branch strings plus an example.com link can establish Accepted without implementation, Review, checks or merge proof; Draft can advance to Ready while Stale; and a latest Rejected record can leave Status at Draft.
findings.trigger: A governance author indents a canonical table, uses a multi-prefix credential key, supplies fabricated evidence, promotes a plan with syntactically plausible but unbound authority text, changes status while Stale or records Rejected without its required recovery state.
findings.impact: Each invalid committed snapshot returns exit 0, overall PASS and all 13 checks PASS. The advertised deterministic evidence can therefore authorize non-rendered governance records, committed production credentials, fabricated evidence and lifecycle states that bypass independent approval or the fail-closed stale/recovery rules; downstream dependency gates may then trust a forged Accepted or Ready state.

evidence.description: PM-REQ-005 through PM-REQ-017, PM-AC-001 and PM-AC-006 through PM-AC-011, design sections 7 and 11, and implementation-plan lines 245-307 define visible canonical records, traceable evidence and secret gates.

The exact-head positive result and supplied 76-case summary reproduce byte-identically with SHA-256 782ed333578fc9dd005843b4c69806be8a67f1a09a23b3485f8e4909cefd490a and 2e3bf8b5c27e8b63bf99568d1a42fb798b05da29d4197fa25b4bcd290f5ce1b3.

The primary four-fixture suite shows an indented portfolio table, a multi-prefix production API key, an unreachable ChangeRecord evidence SHA and an indented ChangeRecord table all receiving 13/13 PASS.

The independent audit demonstrates forged Accepted authority/proof, Draft-to-Ready while Stale and Draft retained after Rejected, all with checker PASS; evidence SHA-256 is 1479e408bfcf2bd11709b53cdcbdf63a40624698bc28992eee7c6bfd43a4e2b6.

findings.remediation: Parse authoritative Markdown structures with CommonMark-equivalent block semantics so fenced, commented, indented-code and raw-HTML-only structures cannot satisfy table or prose contracts. Tokenize credential keys by their terminal sensitive suffix regardless of prefix depth and keep diagnostics redacted. Require every evidence value to resolve to exact immutable authority, including reachable commits and lifecycle/PR/check/merge bindings for promotion. Compare parent-to-head business status, forbid advancement while either projection is Stale and require Rejected to recover to In Progress or Blocked. Add every reproduced case to the mutation-specific harness and remove the currently accepted forged-future-state fixture.
findings.verification: At a new exact live head, valid content must retain byte-stable 13/13 PASS and all legitimate regressions. Every primary and independent invalid fixture must exit 1 with overall FAIL and its mutation-specific diagnostic without disclosing credential values; the harness must reject rather than bless forged Accepted, stale advancement and invalid rejection recovery; refreshed PR digests must bind the new artifacts before re-review.
